hypotheses: Three arbitrary abelian categories with independent object, morphism and HasExt universes; F:C→D→E additive and preserving finite limits and finite colimits in each variable. The linear layer adds an independently sized commutative scalar ring and linearity of each category and both component functors. No injective/projective supply, resolutions, finiteness or invertibility of two.
closed_scope: Native external Ext product and biadditive form
Degree-zero formulas and actual degree-(1,1) minus sign
Full (-1)^(p*q) interchange with explicit total-degree equality
Naturality at each of four endpoints and in natural transformations of the bifunctor
Unsigned source connecting formulas with factors +1 and (-1)^p
Native signed contravariant delta laws with extra factors (-1)^q and +1
Scalar-linear constructor with actual source and target arrows, and tensor evaluation
scope_limits: No target/covariant connecting-map theorem is asserted.
No geometric cup product, symmetric monoidal comparison, Künneth theorem or derived-tensor identification is asserted.
The underlying Ext carriers and maps are the original Mathlib objects; no alternate model or resolution is introduced.

effacement.scope: Resolution-free source effacement in any abelian category with HasExt; Aglib Effacement.lean is not copied.

native_reuse.scalar_proof: Native map_zsmul of Ext.precomp/postcomp, elaborated through explicitly typed local Ext.comp equalities. No replacement instance or scalar model.
native_reuse.signed_diagram: Native IsPullback.shortComplex′, whose second map is biprod.desc q (-r), and native extClass_naturality.

references.scope: Implementation source and exact statement correspondence. The native effacement ingredient retains its own Stacks/Yoneda provenance; no whole-product Stacks tag is inferred.
